---
name: Production-source review
about: Track one rights, privacy or reproducible-build blocker before any source publication
title: "[Source review] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

### Component / file group
Provide module paths, not private files or secrets.

### Rights holder and redistribution permission
Document written authorization, or mark permission as **not yet established**.

### Privacy and security analysis
Describe any API, visitor-data or endpoint concerns without posting private data.

### Third-party licensing
List required approvals, license compatibility and attribution.

### Reproducible build / runtime dependencies
Document what is required for independent verification.

### Review and acceptance criteria
- [ ] Permission validated
- [ ] Privacy/secret scan completed
- [ ] Third-party licenses checked
- [ ] Source (not only a minified distribution) available
- [ ] Build/test steps verified
- [ ] No production user data present
